rationale: C1 is a GO on reducing regulatory compliance burden for businesses in general, through a review and a steering committee. It is not an order to protect traders' business from disruption. C3 and C4 are about price control and consumer protection; C2 and C5 are law syllabi. No dedicated measure.

C2 says a State level GST Grievance Redressal Committee 'will be formed', which is only a statement of intent. C3-C5 are committees for other groups (PDS, crop insurance, pay).

rationale: C1-C3 describe the Vision 2023 document, which was released in 2012 and 2014. C4 and C5 only refer to Vision 2023 as context. No extract shows a progress report on Vision 2023 projects being issued.

rationale: C1-C5 describe TAHDCO subsidy, entrepreneur development and skill training schemes for Adi Dravidar and Tribal people. None shows industrial development centres being set up in every district. Only related activity.

rationale: The GO in C5 (2018-05-18) restructures field administration to ensure effective monitoring of schools and quality of education, a dedicated official measure. The GO in C4 (2019-11-20) sets the Commissioner's functions, including measures to improve quality. C1-C3 are policy-note descriptions.
